items.text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO LOCAL GOVERNMENT

items.actClause: AN ACT to amend chapter 824 of the laws of 1933 relating to creating the Buffalo and Fort Erie Public Bridge Authority, in relation to the occurrence of the cessation of the powers, jurisdiction and duties of the board of such authority
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5191

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend chapter 824 of the laws of 1933
relating to creating the Buffalo and Fort Erie Public Bridge
Authority, in relation to the occurrence of the cessation of the
powers, jurisdiction and duties of the board of such authority

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This bill would allow the Buffalo Fort Erie Public Bridge Authority to
dissolve as it was originally designed to do.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1 reverts back to a prior date for dissolution (July 1, 1992).

JUSTIFICATION:

Originally, the Authority was designed to accomplish its mission
(build a bridge), pay off its bonds, and dissolve. However, this
design was complicated when a date certain time for potential
dissolution was inserted into the legislation. Now, even if the bonds
are paid off, the authority would continue to function, even if they
themselves had determined that the authority had outlived its
usefulness. Nothing in this legislation dissolves the authority; it
simply allows the authority to choose to dissolve by paying off its
outstanding bonds. This measure would allow the authority to determine
when it has stopped being effective, instead of an arbitrary future
date. At such time as the Authority deems their mission to have been
completed, they will pay off their outstanding bonds and the property
owned by the authority will be divided between Canada and the New York
State. Management of the bridge will then occur with both Canada and
New York managing their side of the bridge. Currently, a vast majority
(18 of 23) of international bridges between the US and Canada are
managed in this fashion. If the authority determines that this method
of management is more efficient, they may choose to come inline with
the majority of bridges spanning the US and Canada and dissolve.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

Potential increase in funding for the New York portion of the Peace
Bridge.

EFFECTIVE DATE:

Immediately.
